description: Manually counted visible people per sample image. A person counts if any recognisable part of their body (head, torso or most of a limb) is visible. Statues, reflections and specks too small to identify are not counted.
selection_rule: COCO val2017 in ascending ID order from #10092: the first 2 images with no people, plus every everyday scene with 1-15 unambiguously countable people until 10 were collected. Images skipped by the rule: #12120, #12639, #12670 (crowds over 15 or many tiny background people) and #12280 (count ambiguous: faint person behind glass). Chosen before running the model on any of them.

Four players in front plus one distant player on the far left (~20 px, recognisable when zoomed). Count corrected from 4 to 5 after the model flagged it and a zoomed check confirmed a person. A fainter figure next to it is too unclear to count.
